scientific_integrity: Exact analytic derivative and monotonicity proof supplied; numerical checker provides independent finite consistency tests only. The classical forward line shapes and experimental peak merging are prior results.
scientific_limitations: Exact stationary symmetric two-state frequency jumps, positive homogeneous linewidth and modulation strength, linear response, known switching-rate-axis units, and both coherent-amplitude and absorption readouts. No finite-noise stability, asymmetric-jump, or experimental uncertainty guarantee. Specialized historical-priority comparisons may remain outstanding.
title: A sharp two-channel peak-merger tomography theorem for telegraph frequency noise
